newsitem.title: GREECE: DRACHMA JUMPS ON C.BANK INTERVENTION AT FIX-DEALERS.
newsitem.headline: DRACHMA JUMPS ON C.BANK INTERVENTION AT FIX-DEALERS.

text.p: Bank of Greece, the country's central bank, stepped in and sold large amounts of ecus, marks and dollars for drachmas at the fixing driving the drachma sharply higher, dealers said.
"Bank of Greece intervened heavily and sold large amounts of ecus, marks and $ for drachmas," a forex dealer at a foreign bank said. "The drachma rose sharply afterwards veruss these currencies."
Ecu/drachma dropped to 311.40 from 312.70/80 before the fixing, mark/drachma was set at 159.740, down from 160.40/50, and $/drachma at 270.06 from 271.70/80, they said.
But buying interest for ecus from London-based banks emerged after the fixing pushing ecu/drachma up to 311.60/70, forex dealers said.

"Ecu/drachma has firmed again after the fixing on ecu buying from London-based players. We are currently at 311.60/70," dealers said. "The central bank might have to come out again tomorrow at the fixing or intraday if it wants to strengthen the drachma."

Forex dealers said press reports that Prime Minister Cosats Simitis told union leaders, businessmen on Wednesday that the drachma would be devalued if Greece failed to take the necessary structural measures to secure long-term prosperity had caused concern abroad. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
